easy.label: Easy
easy.blurb: Karakura Town and the road into Soul Society.
easy.spoiler: Safe through the start of the Soul Society arc.

questions.q: What is a Soul Reaper's sword called?
questions.note: Every one of them is unique, and every one has a name.

questions.q: What are the monsters that eat souls called?
questions.note: A Hollow is what a soul becomes when it is left behind too long.

questions.q: Which family does Rukia belong to?
questions.note: One of the four great noble houses. Adopted, as it turns out.

questions.q: What is Ichigo's zanpakuto called?
questions.note: The Slaying Moon.

questions.q: What is Uryu Ishida?
questions.note: The last of a people the Soul Reapers nearly wiped out.

questions.q: What does Yoruichi turn into?
questions.note: With a voice that surprises everyone the first time.

questions.q: What kind of shop does Kisuke Urahara run?
questions.note: The candy is mostly a front.

questions.q: What are the thirteen squads of Soul Reapers called?
questions.note: Each with a captain and a lieutenant.

questions.q: How does Ichigo become a Soul Reaper?
questions.note: She meant to lend a little. He took nearly all of it.

questions.q: What is Orihime's power used for above all?
a: Rejecting injuries so they never happened
questions.note: Not healing, technically — she refuses the event itself.

questions.q: What does a Soul Reaper do to send a wandering soul on to Soul Society?
questions.note: Konso. It is the first thing Rukia is shown doing, and the job the whole organisation exists for.

questions.q: Which captain is Renji's lieutenant to?
questions.note: Squad 6, and a relationship built entirely on Rukia.

questions.q: What is Kon?
a: A modified soul in a stuffed lion
questions.note: Loud, cowardly, and technically contraband.

questions.q: What does Byakuya's zanpakuto turn into?
a: A thousand blades that look like petals
questions.note: Senbonzakura. Beautiful right up until it isn't.

questions.q: Who is the Captain-Commander at the start of the series?
questions.note: Over two thousand years in the job.

questions.q: Where do the Soul Reapers live?
questions.note: The walled inner city — everyone else lives in the Rukongai outside.

medium.label: Medium
medium.blurb: Aizen, the Espada and everything in Hueco Mundo.
medium.spoiler: Spoilers through the whole Arrancar arc and the fake Karakura Town.

questions.q: What does Aizen's zanpakuto do?
a: Complete hypnosis of anyone who has seen its release
questions.note: Kyoka Suigetsu. If you saw the release once, you never saw anything true again.

questions.q: Which two captains leave with Aizen?
questions.note: One of them was never really with him.

questions.q: What is the second release of a zanpakuto called?
questions.note: It usually takes a decade to achieve. Ichigo got three days.

questions.q: Which Espada number is Ulquiorra?
questions.note: Tattooed on his chest. The number is a ranking, not a name.

questions.q: What is the orb Aizen spends the series chasing?
questions.note: Made by Urahara, hidden inside Rukia.

questions.q: What are the Visored?
questions.note: Aizen's earliest experiment. Urahara was exiled for it — the crime was his only in the sense that he was blamed.

questions.q: Which squad does Kenpachi Zaraki captain?
questions.note: The squad that does nothing but fight.

questions.q: What is the name of Ichigo's bankai?
questions.note: It makes the sword smaller. That is the whole point.

questions.q: What is Rukia's shikai?
questions.note: Reputedly the most beautiful zanpakuto in Soul Society.

questions.q: What was Nel before Ichigo met her as a child?
questions.note: Tres Espada, before her own side betrayed her.

questions.q: What does Gin's zanpakuto do?
questions.note: Shinso. And the real trick was never the length.

questions.q: Which squad handles healing?
questions.note: Looked down on by Squad 11, right up until they need it.

questions.q: What is Mayuri Kurotsuchi head of?
questions.note: Squad 12, and the less said about his methods the better.

questions.q: How did Aizen open the Soul Society arc?
a: By opening a gate to Hueco Mundo
questions.note: Impaled on a wall, in front of witnesses, for maximum effect.

questions.q: What is a released Arrancar form called?
questions.note: And a very small number of them have a second one.

questions.q: Soul Reapers call their high-speed movement shunpo. What do the Arrancar call theirs?
questions.note: Every species has its own: hirenkyaku is the Quincy version, Bringer Light the Fullbringer one. Shunko is something else entirely.

hard.label: Hard
hard.blurb: The Thousand-Year Blood War, the Royal Guard, and who Zangetsu really was.
hard.spoiler: Spoilers for the entire series, ending included.

questions.q: Who is the emperor of the Quincy?
questions.note: Sealed for a thousand years, and he counted every one of them.

questions.q: What is Yhwach's power called?
questions.note: He sees every future and can rewrite the one he dislikes.

questions.q: Who was the old man Ichigo thought was Zangetsu?
a: A fragment of Yhwach's power inside him
questions.note: The white hollow was the real Zangetsu the whole time.

questions.q: What was Ichigo's mother, Masaki?
questions.note: Which makes Ichigo the collision of three species.

questions.q: What was Isshin Kurosaki before he was a doctor?
a: A member of the Royal Guard
questions.note: He gave up his powers to save Masaki.

questions.q: What are the Sternritter branded with?
questions.note: Their Schrift — the letter is the ability.

questions.q: Which letter does Uryu receive?
questions.note: The letter of Yhwach's chosen successor.

questions.q: What is Squad Zero also called?
questions.note: Five people who each invented something Soul Society runs on.

questions.q: What is Yamamoto's bankai called?
questions.note: Ryujin Jakka is the shikai. The bankai burns everything it has ever burned.

questions.q: How do the Quincy steal a captain's bankai?
questions.note: Which is why the first invasion goes so badly.

questions.q: What is Kenpachi Zaraki's zanpakuto called?
questions.note: He did not learn its name until the war. He had never asked.

questions.q: Where does Aizen spend the war?
a: Chained in Muken, the deepest prison
questions.note: Level eight of Central 46's prison, brought up only when things are truly bad.

questions.q: What holds the Soul King in place?
a: He is dismembered and sealed as the linchpin of the worlds
A seal made by the Royal Guard
questions.note: Limbs removed and scattered, precisely so that everything holds together.

questions.q: Who is the head of Squad Zero?
questions.note: The monk who names things — and naming is the power.

questions.q: What does Uryu's Antithesis do?
a: Swaps what has happened to two targets
questions.note: Your wounds become theirs, and theirs become yours.

questions.q: Which four Sternritter form Yhwach's elite guard?
questions.note: Pernida, Askin, Gerard and Lille — each one a piece of the Soul King.
